## Predicting whether a promise will be kept

- 1491 resolved promises, 70% fully kept
- Leave-one-company-out AUC **0.766** (90% CI [0.747, 0.787]); company Say-Do score alone 0.5193; Brier 0.174 vs base rate 0.215
- Walk-forward (train on outcomes public before 2025-07-30, n=166; test on later promises, n=754): AUC **0.710** (90% CI [0.674, 0.745]); score-only 0.5079; Brier 0.170 vs 0.169

Top coefficients (positive = more likely kept):

- `horizon_yrs` +2.46
- `ops_spread` +1.65
- `cat_kept_shrunk` +1.58
- `ghost_rate` +1.41
- `cat_high_base` +0.73
- `margin_gap` -0.71
- `muse_forecast_logit` -0.50
- `has_number` -0.46
- `promises_in_call` -0.41
- `grp_fin` -0.39

## Market test (point-in-time, excess vs equal-weight universe)

- 136 call-events, 41 companies: top-tercile Say-Do -0.76% vs bottom +1.27% over 90 days; spread -2.03% (90% CI [-10.01, 5.46]); mean quarterly rank IC -0.028
- Event study (60d): kept revealed +1.61% (n=156), broken revealed +1.47% (n=90), diff +0.14% (90% CI [-3.22, 3.75])

Intervals that include zero mean the test is inconclusive at this sample size.
